Subject: Private edge deployment — quick preflight questions

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the overview this morning. We're trying to lock down the networking and staging window for our private edge rollout (CypherBio Prod region, us-west-2). Before we book the maintenance window we have a couple of short preflight questions to make sure the ops team can prepare: 

- Do we need symmetric NAT traversal for the private endpoints or is outbound-only NAT sufficient?
- Are there any specific IP ranges we must whitelist, or do you provide a CIDR list for your private control plane?
- For the on-prem package, can you confirm which port ranges are required for inter-node gRPC vs. the control-plane heartbeat?

I've attached our current network diagram and a staging checklist — would appreciate a short run-through so we can schedule next Tuesday (Nov 30) for the staging test.

Thanks,
John Sullivan
Senior Infrastructure Manager
CypherBio

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: John Sullivan <john.sullivan@cypherbio.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private edge deployment — quick preflight questions

John — great questions. Short answers up front, and I'll loop Dev and Marissa for details and scheduling.

- NAT: outbound-only NAT is fine for the control-plane APIs, but the inter-node peer discovery in the on-prem package requires inbound connectivity on the private network (we usually ask for symmetric rules inside the VPC peering; if you're doing strict outbound-only egress we can broker via a relay).
- CIDRs: we provide a published CIDR block for the private control plane endpoints per-region. I'll attach the current list for us-west-2 in a follow-up note.
- Ports: inter-node gRPC uses 50051 by default; control-plane heartbeats use 8443/udp for quick health pings and 443/tcp for management. You can rebind on install but we need the mappings for firewall rules.

Proposed next steps:
1) Dev to provide full port/CIDR list and relay option details.
2) CypherBio to confirm whether staging VPC will permit inbound from our staging CIDR or prefers a relay.
3) Schedule a 90-minute staging run with a dry-run of control-plane failover.

Dev — can you paste the official port/CIDR matrix and the relay config? Marissa — can you propose two windows next week for the staging run (one during daytime PST and one late-night maintenance)?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Tessa Morgan

Hey all — adding the technical checklist here (summary + minimal config snippets). See attached install package for staging (redwood_onprem_install_pkg_v0.9.tar.gz).

Network and ports (recommended defaults):
- Control-plane endpoints (us-west-2): 54.212.128.0/22 (redwood control plane), 443/tcp (management), 8443/udp (heartbeat/metrics)
- Inter-node gRPC: 50051/tcp (peer replication); optional: 50052/tcp for KV replication
- Relay (if outbound only): TCP outbound to relay.redwood.internal:443; client connects to relay, relay reverse-proxies into cluster for discovery
- Health checks: TCP 8080 (local health), UDP 8443 for fast liveness

Sample firewall rules (AWS Security Group style):
- Allow outbound 443/tcp to 54.212.128.0/22
- Allow inbound 50051/tcp from nodes within the CypherBio staging CIDR (10.20.0.0/16)
- Allow inbound 8443/udp from Redwood control-plane CIDR

Staging notes:
- We recommend a 3-node staging cluster on identical instance types to production for cache/stability verification.
- Bring your own KMS: the installer will accept an external KMS endpoint; include cert thumbprint in preflight.
- The installer includes an offline bundle for air-gapped installs.

I attached the install package and a small README with how to toggle relay mode. Happy to hop on the call to walk through the bits.

— Dev Patel
Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_onprem_install_pkg_v0.9.tar.gz
